primary_sources.title: Donald J. Trump, OGE Form 278e, annual report (CY2025), certified; released by OGE 30 Jun 2026
primary_sources.notes: 927-page PDF (report pages numbered 'of 847'). Text-extracted and every 'NVIDIA CORP' row read. Part 7 transactions: 53 Nvidia purchases + 12 sales across multiple investment accounts in CY2025 (matches DeKleptocracy's '53 Nvidia investments'). Accounts #2 and #3 show mirrored line-for-line trades (same item numbers/dates/amounts), consistent with model/managed portfolios.

primary_sources.title: BIS press release: 'Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Artificial Intelligence Diffusion Rule, Strengthens Chip-Related Export Controls'
primary_sources.notes: PDF dated May 12, 2025 (some web copies show May 13). Rule's compliance date was to be May 15, 2025. Same release *tightened* China-related controls (Huawei Ascend guidance, Malaysia/Thailand licensing for diversion). The release's stated harm of the rule was downgrading allied countries to 'second-tier' - i.e. the rule was a global tiering framework; China was already under separate 2022/2023 restrictions.

primary_sources.title: Trump Truth Social post allowing Nvidia H200 shipments to approved Chinese customers (25% cut to US)
primary_sources.notes: Formal Commerce framework for H200 sales followed 13 Jan 2026 (per IBTimes/NOTUS reporting on the separate 278-T story).

secondary_sources.note: Cites Guardian/DeKleptocracy. Claims a 'December 9, 2025 trade of $5M-$25M' - CONTRADICTED by the 278e: Dec 9 rows are two $250,001-$500,000 purchases; the only $5M-$25M Nvidia purchase in CY2025 is 18 Aug 2025. Cross-outlet error, not attributed to TheMarker.
Says purchases came 'in the days following' the Dec 2025 H200 announcement: at least three of $250,001-$500,000 - matches 278e (Dec 9 x2, Dec 12).
Advocacy newsletter; same figures as Guardian, no independent detail.
Cites Guardian; internally notes December purchases were after the announcement.
Different, earlier story (May 2026, OGE 278-T, Jan 6/Feb 10 2026 trades). Not the same transactions; do not conflate.
278-T received 14 Jan 2026 covering Nov-Dec 2025; scanned/OCR-poor, appears to list bonds; no Nvidia equity rows found by text search. Equity trades are in the annual 278e.

primary_source_search.guardian_original: not reached (theguardian.com blocked to tool user agent)
primary_source_search.white_house_response_reported: Advisers say trades were executed through automated / third-party-managed portfolios (per BusinessToday).

claims.claim_text: Headline: 'טראמפ רכש מניות אנבידיה לפני שהעניק לחברה הקלות ביצוא' - as applied to the May 2025 AI Diffusion Rule rescission (the leg the lead describes)
claims.verified_figure: OGE 278e p.323/847, Investment Account #6: NVIDIA CORP purchase 5/6/2025, $1,000,001-$5,000,000. BIS initiated rescission of the AI Diffusion Rule on May 12, 2025 (press release date; some copies May 13) - 6 days after the purchase.
claims.note: The order of events supports 'before'. Note that the reported 'one day before' (secondary coverage) is relative to the first press reports of the plan (~May 7), not the formal BIS action. Filings show timing only, not who directed the trade.

claims.claim_text: Lead: Trump bought Nvidia shares 'בשווי מיליוני דולרים' (worth millions of dollars)
claims.verified_figure: May 6, 2025 purchase reported in the $1,000,001-$5,000,000 band; across CY2025 the 278e lists 53 Nvidia purchases incl. seven of $1M+ (one $5,000,001-$25,000,000 on 18 Aug 2025).
claims.note: OGE reports only value bands, so 'millions' is the band floor-to-ceiling, not an exact amount; for the single pre-rescission trade the true value could be just over $1M.

claims.claim_text: Headline 'before granting export relief' as applied to the December 2025 H200 decision (the second leg of the Guardian/DeKleptocracy analysis TheMarker translates)
claims.verified_figure: Trump publicly announced the H200 approval on Dec 8, 2025. 278e Nvidia rows around it: SALE 12/4/2025 $500,001-$1,000,000 (Acct #4); purchases 12/9/2025 $250,001-$500,000 x2 (Accts #2 and #3, mirrored), 12/11 $50,001-$100,000, 12/12 $250,001-$500,000, 12/17 $500,001-$1,000,000. Commerce formalized H200 framework 13 Jan 2026.
claims.note: Purchases came AFTER the public announcement (and were preceded by a sale), so 'before' holds only against the later formal Commerce rule, which was already publicly foreshadowed - the 'bought ahead' implication does not hold for this leg. Body paywalled: we cannot confirm how TheMarker's body framed this leg; verdict applies to the headline's generalization to it. Separate cross-outlet error: BusinessToday's '$5M-$25M on Dec 9' is contradicted by the filing (Dec 9 = 2 x $250,001-$500,000).

claims.claim_text: Implied by headline/lead: the Nvidia purchase timing signals buying ahead of a favorable policy (conflict of interest)
claims.verified_figure: CY2025: 53 Nvidia purchases (and 12 sales) spread across Jan-Dec in 7+ accounts; $1M+ purchases on Jan 29, May 6, Jul 1, Jul 23, Aug 18 ($5M-$25M), Aug 27, Sep 23. Accounts #2/#3 mirror each other line-for-line, consistent with managed/model portfolios.
claims.note: The May 6 trade is real and does precede the rescission, but with Nvidia bought every few weeks all year, almost any policy date is 'preceded' by a purchase; the headline isolates the trade that fits without the base rate. Provisional: the paywalled body may carry the 53-trade context (secondary coverage says DeKleptocracy reported it). The causal question (who directed trades, foreknowledge) is not answerable from the filing.

excluded_claims.claim_text: Lead framing of the May 2025 rule as 'US policy toward China'
excluded_claims.reason: framing without its own figure; noted for context: the AI Diffusion Rule was a global tiering framework and its rescission was paired with tighter China-related guidance, so 'easing on China' is a loose characterization (BIS release).
